name: Vis
source:
Your name is Aeden, from the royal family that rules the newly formed Colonia. Your father, the king, has the kingdom on a tight grip, holding power until the last drop of blood is spilled.

Embark on the adventure that will shape the known world and beyond, while carrying the burden of a dynasty that is destined to follow you even in death. Every decision you will make will represent the pillar or the downfall of your empire.

Forge, kill, corrupt and rule.

[From Patreon]
